metadata.question: Did Victoria and Corpus Christi, Texas receive less than 20 inches of rainfall between June 15 and June 22, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) for rainfall data - Date range: June 15-22, 2018 - Locations: Victoria, TX (~28.8°N, -97.0°W) and Corpus Christi, TX (~27.8°N, -97.4°W) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (it's precipitation data) - Simply sum the daily precipitation over the period 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If both cities have data and rainfall < 20 inches → Answer A - Valid result but >= 20 inches → Answer B - No data (C1), No valid pixels (C2), or calculation failure (C3) → respective codes - Need to check both cities separately ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define locations const victoria = ee.Geometry.Point([-97.0035, 28.8053]); const corpusChristi = ee.Geometry.Point([-97.3964, 27.8006]); // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2018-06-15'; const endDate = '2018-06-23'; // Exclusive end date // 3. Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data available for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Sum precipitation over the period (CHIRPS is in mm/day) const totalPrecip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 5. Extract values for both cities const victoriaStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: victoria, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const corpusStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: corpusChristi, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const victoriaMm = victoriaStats.precipitation; const corpusMm = corpusStats.precipitation; // 6. Validate results if (victoriaMm === null || victoriaMm === undefined || corpusMm === null || corpusMm === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - null values returned."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const victoriaInches = victoriaMm / 25.4; const corpusInches = corpusMm / 25.4; console.log(`Victoria rainfall: ${victoriaInches.toFixed(2)} inches (${victoriaMm.toFixed(1)} mm)`); console.log(`Corpus Christi rainfall: ${corpusInches.toFixed(2)} inches (${corpusMm.toFixed(1)} mm)`); // 7. Check if both received less than 20 inches if (victoriaInches < 20 && corpusInches < 20) { console.log("Both cities received less than 20 inches of rainfall."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("At least one city received 20 inches or more of rainfall."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
data.exec_msg:
CHIRPS images found: 8
Victoria rainfall: 6.70 inches (170.2 mm)
Corpus Christi rainfall: 8.48 inches (215.5 mm)
Both cities received less than 20 inches of rainfall.
<answer>A</answer>
